title: Give me all information regarding the top 10 Ai...

listings.sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           ORDER BY (365 - availability_365) DESC, city ASC, id ASC
         ) AS occupancy_rank
  FROM listings
)
SELECT *
FROM ranked
WHERE occupancy_rank <= 10
ORDER BY city ASC, (365 - availability_365) DESC, id ASC
listings.title: Top 10 listings by occupancy, ordered by city
